title: Group Room Blocks: One Contract per Block
content:
An organiser may hold any number of Group Room Blocks, at the same or different hotels and on the same or different dates. Each block is a separate contract with its own booking code, its own deposits, its own pickup and its own master account. No maximum number of blocks per organiser is set.

### Points of judgement

**May one organiser hold two blocks at the same hotel on the same dates?** Yes. The rule admits any number of blocks, at the same or different hotels and on the same or different dates.

**Is there a ceiling on how many blocks an organiser may contract?** No ceiling is set; the number of blocks per organiser is unlimited.

**Do two blocks of one organiser share a booking code, deposits, pickup or a master account?** No. Every block is its own contract and keeps its own code, deposits, pickup and master account.

| Item | Belongs to |
|---|---|
| Booking code | the one block it was issued for |
| Deposits | the one block they were paid on |
| Pickup | the one block the attendee reservations name |
| Master account | the one block it was opened for |
